platform: native Windows x64, Node24, actual NTFS DACL/file operations, local HTTP and isolated embedded PostgreSQL; no live provider accounts
problem: Normal CLI startup and onboarding initialized local_encrypted paths using POSIX file modes on Windows. Doctor protected only the new key file, leaving its directory unverified; onboarding/configure did not establish real private Windows ACLs. The hardened server provider correctly rejected the resulting storage during managed agent identity encryption, producing the observed agent-create HTTP500.
causalEvidence: The original API500 response was redacted. Source call path run->doctor(repair)->agent identity provider plus native first-byte DACL gates independently establish the incompatible storage creation behavior; do not claim the original server exposed its private error stack.
changes: Windows ensureLocalSecretsKeyFile and secretsCheck now share the same private master-key loader/read contract as the server. Missing directories and keys are privately/atomically initialized before payload bytes; existing broad/reparse/invalid storage is refused without ACL repair or regeneration.

Once an existing file was observed, later read failure cannot authorize a new key. Doctor distinguishes initial missing/warn/repairable from existing unverifiable or malformed/fail/nonrepairable. Existing POSIX logic and key formats remain unchanged.

Actual company import/export E2E retains file-backed AES initialization. No env-key fixture bypass was introduced; first-run key/parent DACL checks were added and its agent identity service performs real encrypt/decrypt verification.

Onboarding/doctor tests now allocate owned native PAPERCLIP_HOME/HOME/USERPROFILE/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA paths. Company E2E children also receive native home overrides. Per-case default master-key paths no longer depend on the ambient user profile.

Tests track the actual asynchronous command promise, await it before releasing environment/cwd, and delete only roots registered by their own exclusive mkdtemp calls. Rejections are not swallowed; timeout/failure may be reported by both body and teardown.

Only tests actually executing native ACL initialization receive Windows20s/POSIX5s budgets; the ordinary invalid-config rejection stays at its prior default. The production ACL inspector deadline remains ten seconds.
